sql: SELECT AVG(CAST(SUBSTR(fastestLapTime, 1, INSTR(fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(fastestLapTime, INSTR(fastestLapTime, ':') + 1) AS REAL)) FROM results WHERE driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Lewis' AND surname = 'Hamilton') AND fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL AND fastestLapTime != ''
